weak_anomalies.score_type: heuristic composite; not a calibrated probability
weak_anomalies.method: Fixed-denominator weighted sum of reliability-adjusted category maxima (weights 1,1.2,1.2,1 by default; denominator 4.4). Verified model/ledger violations force risk 100. Unavailable checks only change confidence/coverage. Experimental evidence remains visible and may require REVIEW.
